title: MedicationReading
description: Structured reading of a medication label / prescription image, produced on-device by the VLM. EDUCATIONAL INFORMATION ONLY, NOT MEDICAL ADVICE. Records only what is visible; never guesses drug names or dosages.

items.description: One entry per distinct medication legible in the image. Empty if none are legible.

unreadable.description: true if the image is not a legible medication label/prescription at all. When true, items should be empty.

disclaimer.description: Fixed safety disclaimer, always present and shown to the user.

name.description: Drug name exactly as visible on the label, or null if not legible. MUST NOT be guessed or inferred.

dosage.description: e.g. '500 mg', as visible. null if not legible.

frequency.description: e.g. '每日三次', as visible. null if not legible.

appearance.description: Visible appearance, e.g. '白色圓形錠劑'.

purpose_general.description: General, educational description of what this class of drug is commonly used for. NOT personalized advice, NOT a diagnosis. null if the drug is not clearly identified.

unclear_fields.description: Names of fields that were not legible in the image.
